title: CLI shape: shallow (5-task session)
description: Exercises a 5-task session against a fake `moose` CLI whose surface uses the shallow shape: mixed top-level verbs with some subcommand trees (mirrors real Moose). Measures whether the agent can complete all five related operations and how much exploration each shape demands.
lede: Most verbs are top-level, with a small set of subcommanded trees (matches real Moose). The agent must initialise a project, seed a remote ClickHouse, check running processes, list tables, and search logs, in that order.

tasks.description: Initialise a Moose project named events using the python-ckh template.
Seed the local ClickHouse from a remote ClickHouse URL.
List the Tables in the running project.
Search the Moose logs for the term 'error'.

infrastructure.description: No databases or external services. The simulated `moose` wrapper for the shallow variant is installed at /usr/local/bin/moose and logs every invocation as JSON to /workspace/moose.log.
